description: On a 375px phone nothing is wider than the screen on the pages with the widest blocks: home (match cards and countdown), matches, stats and a rival page

steps.eval: (async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const W = document.documentElement.clientWidth; return ![...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].some((e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width && r.right > W + 1; }); })()
